query: How many countries have recognized same-sex marriage?

results.title: Same-sex marriage - Wikipedia
results.content:
As of 2026,[update] marriage between same-sex couples is legally performed and recognized in 38 countries, with a total population of 1.5 billion people (20% of the world's population).
The Oxford English Dictionary has recognized same-sex marriage since 2000.
Since then, same-sex marriage has been established by law in 38 other countries, including most of the Americas and Western Europe.
As of 2025, 38 states have legalized in some capacity.

results.title: Gay Marriage Around the World | Pew Research Center
results.content:
Since the first same-sex marriages were legally recognized in the Netherlands in 2001, nearly 40 other jurisdictions – mostly in Europe and the Americas – have enacted laws allowing gay and lesbian couples to marry.
Greece — 2024 — Europe — First majority-Orthodox Christian nation to legalize same-sex marriage.
Netherlands — 2001 — Europe — First country to legalize same-sex marriage after its Parliament passed the law in December 2000.

results.title: Key facts about same-sex marriage around the world, 25 years after the Netherlands legalized it | Pew Research Center
results.content:
Key facts about same-sex marriage around the world, 25 years after the Netherlands legalized it
April 1 marks the 25th anniversary of the world’s first nationally recognized same-sex marriages.
Same-sex marriage is legal in nearly 40 places worldwide, according to a Center analysis from June 2025.
The most recent countries to legalize same-sex marriage include Estonia, Greece and Nepal in 2024 and Liechtenstein and Thailand in 2025.
